### NETSCOUT to Report Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results on November 5th


October 22, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/726993193/files/doc_news/NETSCOUT-to-Report-Second-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2027-Financial-Results-on-November-5th-2026.pdf)


WESTFORD, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[NETSCOUT SYSTEMS, INC.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.netscout.com%2F&esheet=54626700&newsitemid=20261022554259&lan=en-US&anchor=NETSCOUT+SYSTEMS%2C+INC.&index=1&md5=057fb01fa88c77313ea38bbcaae58674) (NASDAQ: NTCT), a leading provider of network observability, AIOps, carrier service assurance, cybersecurity, and DDoS attack protection, plans to announce its second quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at approximately 7:30 a.m. ET. NETSCOUT will host a corresponding conference call and live webcast on the same day at 8:30 a.m. ET.


The number for the conference call is (800) 267-6316, or (203) 518-9783 for international callers. The conference call ID is NTCTQ227. A replay of the call will be available after 12:00 p.m. ET on November 5th for approximately one week. The number for the replay is (800) 839-3616, or (402) 220-2974 for international callers. An[archived](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.netscout.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54626700&newsitemid=20261022554259&lan=en-US&anchor=archived&index=2&md5=14c9d6655fe6a471d0670c16b21156ec) version of the webcast, press release, and conference call remarks will be available on NETSCOUT’s[website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.netscout.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54626700&newsitemid=20261022554259&lan=en-US&anchor=website&index=3&md5=00e8e37eb74f54f61dbd981384d73d3c) for one year.


**About NETSCOUT**


NETSCOUT SYSTEMS, INC. (NASDAQ: NTCT) protects the connected world from cyberattacks and performance and availability disruptions through its unique visibility platform and solutions powered by its pioneering deep packet inspection at scale technology. As a leading provider of network observability, AIOps, carrier service assurance, cybersecurity, and Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attack protection solutions, NETSCOUT serves the world’s largest enterprises, service providers, and public sector organizations. Learn more at[www.netscout.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.netscout.com&esheet=54626700&newsitemid=20261022554259&lan=en-US&anchor=www.netscout.com&index=4&md5=6819f0da9423a84859174537be9909d0) or follow @NETSCOUT on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fnetscout%2F&esheet=54626700&newsitemid=20261022554259&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=5&md5=41e1753aaeeca2434074941c6feaa894) ,[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FNETSCOUT&esheet=54626700&newsitemid=20261022554259&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=6&md5=167b52ff71ebd8837636ac010d723067) , or[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fnetscoutinc%2F&esheet=54626700&newsitemid=20261022554259&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=7&md5=0dfd001a5bb6606c81f8db5ffae260a6) .
